_comment: Demand scoring for scripts/demand-report.mjs. Five tiers are reported separately and never merged into one count: engagement (filtered, unique daily views), registrations (unique per e-mail and agent), highIntent (registration with a near timeframe, a supported Microsoft environment and a described use case), qualified (a person recorded salesQualification stage qualified or higher) and validatedIntent (stage pilot-agreed or purchase-intent). A corporate e-mail and a timeframe alone never make a lead qualified. Each tier is normalised to 0-1 across agents before weighting, so heavy anonymous traffic cannot outrank a real opportunity. An agent below the minimum signals is reported as insufficient data and not ranked.
